description: Graded evaluation set for The Vault /ask pipeline. Each record is scored 0/1 by an LLM judge against `reference`. `trick: true` marks a question a general-purpose model cannot answer from training alone - the answer lives only in the corpus. `flavour` names the single most salient kind of trick the question exercises: `specific-figure` (an exact number, amount, rate, count, or duration - including table-row lookups - that must be reproduced verbatim), `contradicts-common-knowledge` (the corpus answer conflicts with what a general model would otherwise assert), `paraphrase-vs-quote` (the question demands exact wording a model is tempted to paraphrase or complete from memory), `cross-document` (answering needs facts combined from two or more corpus files), `clause-reference` (the answer is, or centrally includes, a pointer to a numbered clause, section, sub-clause, or schedule), `unanswerable` (the corpus does not contain the answer and the pipeline should decline - `sources` and `sections` are empty), or `""` (a plain lookup a general model can answer). `sources` and `sections` (parallel lists) point at the corpus file(s) and section breadcrumb(s) where the answer is stated.

questions.question: What is the maximum break-cost a customer can be charged on an Acme loan, and what is that cap based on?
questions.reference: The break-cost is capped at a maximum of three (3) times the most recent monthly interest charge on the loan, regardless of the outcome of the calculation in clause 4.3(a).
sections: Personal Lending Policy > 4. Contract Terms

questions.question: What minimum Equifax comprehensive credit score does Acme require of personal-loan applicants?
questions.reference: A minimum Equifax comprehensive credit score of 550.
sections: Personal Lending Policy > 2. Eligibility

questions.question: What interest-rate sensitivity buffer does Acme apply above the offered rate when testing serviceability?
questions.reference: A serviceability interest-rate sensitivity of +2.5 percentage points above the offered rate.
sections: Personal Lending Policy > 3. Responsible Lending

questions.question: According to the RG 209 working synthesis, how many inquiry, verification, and assessment obligations must a licensee have discharged for the 'not-unsuitable' standard to be satisfied?
questions.reference: All eight (8) inquiry, verification, and assessment obligations.
sections: ASIC RG 209 — Working Synthesis > 1. Overview

questions.question: Per the RG 209 synthesis, which Schedule of the Act sets out civil penalties for contraventions of the responsible-lending obligations?
questions.reference: Schedule 2 to the Act. The synthesis also notes these penalties are not reduced by reason of the licensee's good faith.
sections: ASIC RG 209 — Working Synthesis > 1. Overview

questions.question: Where was the One Ring forged?
questions.reference: On the anvils of Eregion, in the year 1600 of the Second Age. The Charter explicitly rejects the popular retelling that places the forging in Mount Doom.
sections: The Silmaril Charter > 4. IV. Of the Ring — a Minor Correction

questions.question: To whom was the third Silmaril entrusted?
questions.reference: Elrond Half-elven, that he might bear it across the Sundering Seas in the hour of exile.
sections: The Silmaril Charter > 2. II. Of the Custodians

questions.question: In what year, and in what place, was the oath sworn?
questions.reference: In the year 1495 of the Years of the Trees, sworn in the square of Tirion beneath the light of the mingling.
sections: The Silmaril Charter > 3. III. Of the Oath

questions.question: Quote exactly what Gandalf says in the Silmaril Charter about the Ring.
questions.reference: "The Ring is altogether evil, and it grows hot in the hand - hotter than any mortal hand should bear."
sections: The Silmaril Charter > 5. V. Of Gandalf's Warning

questions.question: Acme must acknowledge a hardship notice and a written complaint within different timeframes. What are the two windows, and which is faster?
questions.reference: A hardship notice is acknowledged within 2 business days; a written complaint is acknowledged within 1 business day. The complaint acknowledgement is faster, by 1 business day.
sections: Financial Hardship Policy > 2. Assessment
Complaints Handling Policy > 3. Acknowledgement

questions.question: A borrower cancels an approved loan within the cooling-off window and then lodges a complaint about how the cancellation was handled. How long is the cooling-off window, and how long does Acme have to acknowledge the complaint?
questions.reference: The cooling-off period is 14 business days from contract signing. The complaint must be acknowledged within 1 business day of receipt.
sections: Personal Lending Policy > 4. Contract Terms
Complaints Handling Policy > 3. Acknowledgement

sections: Personal Loan — Product Information > 1. Loan Details

questions.question: What loan terms, in years, can an Acme personal-loan borrower choose?
questions.reference: 3, 5, or 7 years.
sections: Personal Loan — Product Information > 1. Loan Details

questions.question: What is Acme's indicative interest rate range for the personal loan?
questions.reference: 6.99% to 22.99% per annum.

questions.question: What establishment fee does Acme charge on a personal loan, and when is it charged?

questions.question: What is Acme's monthly account fee on the personal loan?
questions.reference: $10 per month, charged in arrears.

questions.question: What fee does Acme charge for a dishonoured scheduled payment?
questions.reference: A dishonour fee of $15 per dishonoured scheduled payment.

questions.question: How long does Acme have to complete and communicate a full hardship assessment after a hardship notice?
questions.reference: Within 21 calendar days of the date of the notice.

questions.question: What is the maximum length of a repayment pause Acme will grant for a single hardship event?
questions.reference: A maximum of 90 consecutive days per hardship event.

questions.question: What are Acme Operations' customer support hours?
questions.reference: 08:00 to 18:00 AEST, Monday to Friday, excluding NSW public holidays.

questions.question: What is Acme's SLA for completing verification once all requested customer documents have been received?
questions.reference: 3 business days, measured from the time all requested documents have been received.

questions.question: After how many days of an unresolved complaint does Acme inform the customer of their right to go to AFCA?
questions.reference: If the complaint is not resolved within 30 calendar days, the customer is informed of their right to refer the matter to the Australian Financial Complaints Authority (AFCA).

questions.question: What does AFCA stand for?
questions.reference: The Australian Financial Complaints Authority.

questions.question: Which Australian regulator's guidance is RG 209?

questions.question: What minimum buffer does Acme apply to a customer's declared living expenses when the HEM benchmark is below the declared amount?

questions.question: Under the Operations SLA Handbook, what happens on day 5 of verification, and who carries out the resulting review?

questions.question: Per the RG 209 working synthesis, how long must a licensee retain the suitability assessment, and on what terms must it be given to the consumer?
